main_measure.name: 24-bar forward return, top-decile forecast minus zero-forecast bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if positive with t >= 2 (and supporting check holds); reject if negative with t <= -2, or |t| < 2 with >= 150 cases and estimate within +/-0.1% per 24 bars; fewer than 150 non-overlapping top-decile cases is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: coins with return per unit avg exposure minus buy-and-hold > 0 (need >= 2)

decided_by: |t| < 2 but the estimate lies outside the +/-0.1% near-zero bound.
reading: Top decile is forecast >= the 90th percentile of all pooled bars' forecasts (and > 0), returns are sampled on each window's 0, 24, 48... grid, the per-coin supporting measure sums bar gains over all windows divided by mean |allocation| minus the summed coin returns over the same bars, and 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' is applied literally as at least 2 positive coins among those present.
